document.name: Little Sharks Playground Open Play
document.shortDescription: Little Sharks Playground publishes Wednesday-Sunday open play in Staten Island for children ages 1-11, with a 10 a.m.-6 p.m. schedule on its official site.
document.longDescription:
Little Sharks Playground describes itself as a Staten Island indoor playground for kids and families, with slides, ball pits, tunnels, and other active-play features. The official homepage states that the space is for children 1-11 years old.

The same page publishes open-play availability Wednesday through Sunday from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. Those posted hours support weekday, weekend, morning, afternoon, and after-school tags for this listing.

Official contact information shown on the homepage includes 27 Brienna Ct, Staten Island, NY 10309 and phone (718) 612-5867. The homepage reviewed did not publish a public drop-in admission price, so pricing is stored as unknown.

Sources: https://www.littlesharksplayground.com https://static.wixstatic.com/media/c30376_46590d34d32b4b858bb236593df085fe~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_1346,h_578,al_c,q_85,enc_avif,quality_auto/P11_edited.jpg
